description:
An exploration of James Lindsay's theory of the "Secret Religion of the West" and its historical roots in Gnosticism and Hermeticism. Through excerpts from his lecture and supporting historical references, this video examines the claim that certain philosophical and religious ideas have continued to influence modern institutions, culture, and public discourse.
